newsitem.title: USA: USG low sulphur jet fuel gains in brisk activity.
newsitem.headline: USG low sulphur jet fuel gains in brisk activity.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices firmed Tuesday, boosted by the gains in the NYMEX basis price.
Some brisk trading in low sulphur grade on the Gulf Coast also contributed to strength in the market, according to traders.
Prompt 55-grade low sulphur jet fuel changed hands at 0.20, 0.25 and 0.40 cents over the July NYMEX, up from about even with the futures late Monday.
However, prompt 54-grade jet fuel saw little change, with Gulf Coast barrels talked near flat with the July NYMEX, traders said.
The NYMEX July heating oil futures gained 0.51 cent to settle at 52.45 cents a gallon.
